name: Transmission & Chromatic Dispersion Ray Marching
definition: Handles light transmission through transparent surfaces using refraction, with optional chromatic dispersion by splitting rays into R, G, B channels based on IOR spread.
summary: Transmission & Chromatic Dispersion Ray Marching simulates light refraction through transparent surfaces, uniquely splitting rays into Red, Green, and Blue channels based on wavelength-dependent index of refraction to create spectral separation effects.
